Delhi Metro Stations Shut, Trains Cancelled Ahead of Protest

Ahead of a protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar, authorities closed entry and exit gates at 57 Delhi Metro stations, with services suspended until further notice. Trains to Delhi were also cancelled, and internet services were affected. The Supreme Court had directed the Centre and police to lift "blanket curbs."
